description.zh:
结束时间戳。

单位：毫秒。

> 结束时间无限制，可以设置为未来的某个时间。
description.en:
The end timestamp.

Unit: milliseconds.

> The end time has no limit and can be set to a future time.
The dimension information of the metric.

description.zh:
监控项维度的键。

监控项维度的格式：key-value键值对形式的集合，例如：`instanceId:i-2ze2d6j5uhg20x47****`或`userId:120886317861****`。

关于如何获取监控项的维度，请参见[云产品监控项](~~163515~~)中的参数`Dimension`。
description.en:
The key of the metric dimension.

The metric dimension is in the format of a collection of key-value pairs, for example, `instanceId:i-2ze2d6j5uhg20x47****` or `userId:120886317861****`.

For information about how to obtain the dimensions of a metric, see the `Dimension` parameter in [Cloud service metrics](~~163515~~).

description.zh:
监控项维度的匹配关系。

目前仅支持EQUALS（等于）。
description.en:
The matching relationship of the metric dimension.

Currently, only EQUALS is supported.

description.zh:
监控项维度的值。

监控项维度的格式：key-value键值对形式的集合，例如：`instanceId:i-2ze2d6j5uhg20x47****`或`userId:120886317861****`。

关于如何获取监控项的维度，请参见[云产品监控项](~~163515~~)中的参数`Dimension`。
description.en:
The value of the metric dimension.

The metric dimension is in the format of a collection of key-value pairs, for example, `instanceId:i-2ze2d6j5uhg20x47****` or `userId:120886317861****`.

For information about how to obtain the dimensions of a metric, see the `Dimension` parameter in [Cloud service metrics](~~163515~~).

description.zh:
云产品的监控项名称。

关于如何获取云产品的监控项名称，请参见[云产品监控项](~~163515~~)。
description.en:
The metric name of the cloud service.

For information about how to obtain the metric name of a cloud service, see [Cloud service metrics](~~163515~~).

description.zh:
云产品的数据命名空间。

关于如何获取云产品的数据命名空间，请参见[云产品监控项](~~163515~~)。
description.en:
The data namespace of the cloud service.

For information about how to obtain the data namespace of a cloud service, see [Cloud service metrics](~~163515~~).

description.zh:
监控项的时间间隔。

单位：秒。

> 监控项的时间间隔通常为60秒。特殊取值，请参见[云产品监控项](~~163515~~)中的参数`Period`。
description.en:
The interval of the metric.

Unit: seconds.

> The interval of a metric is typically 60 seconds. For special values, see the `Period` parameter in [Cloud service metrics](~~163515~~).

description.zh:
开始时间戳。

单位：毫秒。

> 由于云监控中的监控数据只能保存90天，建议开始时间与当前时间间隔小于等于90天。
description.en:
The start timestamp.

Unit: milliseconds.

> Because monitoring data in CloudMonitor is retained for only 90 days, the interval between the start time and the current time should be no more than 90 days.

title.zh: 获取导出数据初始游标
title.en: Obtain initial cursor for data export

descriptions.zh:
### 前提条件
请确保您已开通企业云监控。具体操作，请参见[开通企业云监控](~~250773~~)。

### 背景信息
先调用本接口获取初始的Cursor，再调用BatchGet接口导出监控数据。更多信息，请参见[BatchGet](~~391205~~)。

### 使用说明
本文将提供一个示例，定义云产品`acs_ecs_dashboard`的监控项`cpu_idle`在时间段`1641627000000`（2022-01-08 15:30:00）至`1641645000000`（2022-01-08 20:30:00）内每60秒的数据导出范围。返回结果显示`Cursor`信息。
descriptions.en:
### Before you begin
Make sure that you have activated Hybrid Cloud Monitoring. For more information, see [Activate Hybrid Cloud Monitoring](~~250773~~).

### Background information
Call this operation to obtain the initial Cursor, and then call the BatchGet operation to export monitoring data. For more information, see [BatchGet](~~391205~~).

### Operation description
This topic provides an example on how to define the export scope for the `cpu_idle` metric of the `acs_ecs_dashboard` cloud service at 60-second intervals from `1641627000000` (2022-01-08 15:30:00) to `1641645000000` (2022-01-08 20:30:00). The `Cursor` information is returned.
